::: {.minipage data-latex="{\textwidth}"}
### `ReduceImageBleedThrough` {-}

Lightens faint bleed-through (i.e., text or images showing through from the reverse side of a scanned page) and saves the result to another image file.
Returns true if image was successfully saved.

#### Syntax {-}

``` {.lua}
boolean ReduceImageBleedThrough(string inputImagePath,
                                string outputImagePath,
                                number whitePoint)
```


#### Return value {-}

Type: `boolean`

#### Parameters {-}

**Parameter** | **Description**
| :-- | :-- |
| `string` inputImagePath | The input image. |
| `string` outputImagePath | Where to save the image. |
| `number` whitePoint | (Optional) The channel value (from `0` to `255`) at or above which a pixel is treated as background and pushed to white.<br>\linebreak Lower values are more aggressive at suppressing faint bleed-through.<br>\linebreak Default is `200`. |


:::
